newsitem.title: UK: France, Morocco in talks on grain credit extension.
newsitem.headline: France, Morocco in talks on grain credit extension.

text.p: France and Morocco are discussing plans to extend a COFACE credit line for the purchase of French wheat that is due to expire on June 30, a Moroccan grain official said on Thursday.
"Yes, there are discussions. But that is all we can say at the moment," the official told a reporter at an International Grains Council conference in London.
The initial credit line to buy 1.0 million tonnes of French soft wheat had been opened on July 28, 1995. Some 227,000 tonnes are still unused.
Latest statistics from the IGC suggest that Morocco may import 2.2 million tonnes of wheat in 1996/97 against 1.4 million in the previous season. - - London Newsroom +44 171 542 7729
